# Md. Yaleed Haque

## Profile
C#/.NET and Kotlin/Android engineer in Dhaka, Bangladesh — open to remote.
Ships complete, offline-first products end to end: 30 repositories, MIT/Apache-2.0
licensed, most with CI and automated test suites. Works close to the metal — Win32
APIs, Bluetooth GATT/HID, UDP/TCP, sensors — with no cloud dependency.
Seeking a full-time role in C#/.NET desktop, Android/Kotlin, or AI-agent tooling.

## Verified facts
- 295 registered desktop automation commands in StarkAgent Core/CommandCatalog.cs
- ~15,500 lines of production C# (StarkAgent)
- ~27,800 lines of TypeScript (Family Tapestry), 239 Vitest tests across 16 files
- 347 Python tests across 22 files (AI Browser Toolkit)
- 7 Supabase migrations with row-level security enabled (Family Tapestry)

## Public repositories (open for review)
- yale-doc-yaleed: Self-encrypting single-file HTML document editor. AES-256-GCM,
  PBKDF2-SHA256, encrypted version history, attachments, offline, zero dependencies.
  Verified on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. https://github.com/yaleedhaque/yale-doc-yaleed
- YaleVPN-PC: Desktop WireGuard + Cloudflare WARP client for Linux and Windows —
  on-device keys, egress IP rotation, kill switch, DNS pinning, GUI + CLI.
  https://github.com/yaleedhaque/YaleVPN-PC
- yalevpn: WireGuard VPN + Shizuku integration research lab for Android.
  https://github.com/yaleedhaque/yalevpn
- proctor-free: Browser-based exam proctoring with all AI running client-side.
  No servers, no tracking. https://github.com/yaleedhaque/proctor-free
- StarkAgent: Fully autonomous Windows desktop control agent, 295+ commands
  (OCR, UIA, Vision, MCP, CDP browser control, DirectX capture, WhatsApp driver).
  C#/.NET 8, MIT, ~15.5k LOC. https://github.com/yaleedhaque/StarkAgent
- Ai-Browser-Toolkit: Drive real Chrome/Edge over a JSON API — one persistent
  profile, full DOM control, 347 tests. Python, Apache-2.0.
  https://github.com/yaleedhaque/Ai-Browser-Toolkit

## Private repositories (source available on request)
These are built and shipping but kept private by default. Code and architecture
walkthrough are available on request.
- yale-agent: Wayland-native Linux desktop agent, 68 tools in 11 categories via
  MCP server, CLI and web dashboard. Python.
- precise-hands: MCP server for exact-coordinate automation (AT-SPI, XDG portal,
  uiautomator bounds to input tap). Python.
- BluetoothRemoteHid: Phone as wireless keyboard/touchpad/air-mouse over Bluetooth
  Classic + LE HID, no host software. Kotlin.
- GamePadEcosystem: Android phones as wireless Xbox 360 controllers, sub-5 ms
  latency. C#/.NET 8 host + Kotlin/Compose client.
- Lumen: Offline torch with Morse send and camera-based Morse decode. Kotlin/Compose.
- AetherCompass: Offline compass with accurate bearings. Kotlin/Compose.
- OmniFetch-Android: On-device video search/stream/download with bundled
  yt-dlp + ffmpeg and a gesture player. Kotlin/Compose.
- family-tapestry: Collaborative graph-based family tree with real-time presence,
  timeline, map and multi-format export. Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase (RLS),
  React Flow, Leaflet. 239 tests, 27.8k LOC. Source private by design; the live
  app is open to all users: https://family-tapestry-nine.vercel.app
- bkash-ecommerce: bKash + WhatsApp storefront template for local shops with
  admin dashboard. Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase.
  Live: https://bkash-ecommerce.vercel.app
- Edge-project: Self-hosted on-device speech-to-text (faster-whisper + ffmpeg),
  word-timed transcripts, no cloud and no API keys. Python.
- stark-hotspot: Concurrent WiFi STA+AP on one radio (hostapd + dnsmasq + NAT).
- haque-squad: Authoritative-server multiplayer arena shooter (Godot 4) with
  phone browser touch controllers over WebSocket.
- opencode-dotfiles, opencode-setup-kit, opencode-free-fallback, yaleed-install:
  AI agent infrastructure — version-controlled agent brain, one-command
  workstation provisioning, free-tier model fallback, environment restore.

## Tech Stack
C# (.NET 8), Kotlin (Jetpack Compose), Android (Bluetooth HID/GATT, CameraX,
sensors), Windows Win32, ViGEm, SendInput, TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase (RLS),
React Flow, Leaflet, Python (FastAPI, MCP, Playwright), Godot 4 / GDScript,
Shell (systemd, hostapd), PowerShell.
